referral.subject: EasyPhysio invitation – my rehab follow-up
referral.body:
Hello,

I'd like to use EasyPhysio to follow my rehab programme with you. Could you create your account on EasyPhysio and invite me from your space?

easyphysio.fr

Thank you!
